draft5_answer: TO TEST Failure, replacement, ejection or owner bump of a predecessor increments the queue epoch and invalidates every descendant ticket and result. draft5_answer: TO TEST Git/SQLite consistency needs an intent before ref movement and idempotent reconciliation after it.
